tools.name: alterlab_scrape
tools.title: Scrape URL
tools.summary: Fetch any URL and return clean markdown, text, HTML, or JSON, with automatic website compatibility through 5-tier escalation
tools.description: Fetch one URL and return its content as clean markdown, text, HTML, or JSON. Use when a normal fetch returns 403/429, a bot-protection challenge page, a CAPTCHA, or an empty JavaScript shell. Website challenges and JavaScript-heavy pages are handled automatically by a 5-tier system that starts at the cheapest tier that works and escalates only when needed. Returns markdown by default, ready for LLM context. Supports GET and POST via method, structured extraction via extraction_schema or extraction_prompt, and cost caps via cost_controls. Supports browser actions via actions, plus screenshot and generate_pdf; the response includes action_results, one entry per action with index, type, success, error, result (evaluate) and screenshot_url (screenshot actions).

method.description: HTTP method. POST is for GraphQL, forms and REST APIs. Default: GET.

mode.description: Scraping mode: auto (recommended), html, js (headless browser), pdf, or ocr Default: auto.

formats.description: Output formats. 'markdown' is best for LLM consumption. Default: ["markdown"].

extraction_schema.description: JSON schema for structured extraction. Fields matching this schema are extracted from the page. Example: { "title": "string", "price": "number" }. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

extraction_prompt.description: Natural language extraction instruction. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

render_js.description: Render JavaScript with a headless browser. 'auto' renders only when needed. Default: false.

use_proxy.description: Route through a premium proxy. Default: false.

cost_controls.description: Cap spending, pin a tier, or trade off cost vs speed.

estimate_first.description: Run a free cost estimate before scraping. Default: false.

tools.name: alterlab_extract
tools.title: Extract Structured Data
tools.summary: Extract structured data (prices, product info, custom fields) from HTML, text, or markdown you already have
tools.description: Extract structured data (prices, product info, contact details, custom fields) as JSON from HTML, text or markdown you already hold. Use when you have content and need specific fields. Does not fetch a URL: to fetch and extract in one step, use alterlab_scrape with extraction_schema. LLM extraction (extraction_prompt, extraction_schema) requires your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one it fails with byok_key_required.

content_type.description: Format of the content you pass. Default: html.

extraction_schema.description: JSON schema for structured extraction. Fields matching this schema are extracted from the page. Example: { "title": "string", "price": "number" }. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

extraction_prompt.description: Natural language extraction instruction. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

evidence.description: Return supporting evidence for each field. Default: false.

tools.name: alterlab_screenshot
tools.title: Capture Screenshot
tools.summary: Capture a full-page PNG screenshot of any URL, including anti-bot-protected sites
tools.description: Capture a full-page PNG screenshot of one URL, an image rather than text content. Use when a normal fetch returns 403/429, a bot-protection challenge page, a CAPTCHA, or an empty JavaScript shell. Works on anti-bot-protected sites, rendered in a real headless browser. Use wait_for to wait for an element and wait_until to control load timing. Pass actions (for example dismiss_consent or evaluate) to prepare the page; the screenshot is captured after they run and action_results is returned.

tools.name: alterlab_crawl
tools.title: Crawl Website
tools.summary: Crawl an entire website for RAG or indexing — discovers and scrapes every page on a domain
tools.description: Crawl a whole website and return the content of every page, for RAG, indexing or site-wide export. Use when you need many pages from one domain; for one URL use alterlab_scrape, for a URL list only use alterlab_map. Works on JavaScript-heavy and protected sites, with anti-bot handling on every page. Returns a crawl_id immediately; results are available from GET /api/v1/crawl/{crawl_id}.

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth from the start URL. Default: 3.

extraction_schema.description: JSON schema for structured extraction. Fields matching this schema are extracted from the page. Example: { "title": "string", "price": "number" }. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

render_js.description: Render JavaScript with a headless browser. 'auto' renders only when needed. Default: false.

use_proxy.description: Route through a premium proxy. Default: false.

include_subdomains.description: Include subdomains of the site. Default: false.

tools.name: alterlab_search
tools.title: Search the Web
tools.summary: Search the web and get structured SERP results, optionally scraping each result page
tools.description: Search the web and get structured results (URLs, titles, snippets). Use when you have a question or topic but no URL yet; follow up with alterlab_scrape to read a page, or set scrape_results=true to read every result in one call. Use domain to restrict to one site and time_range to filter by recency.

num_results.description: Number of results to return. Default: 10.

scrape_results.description: Also scrape each result page. Default: false.

extraction_schema.description: JSON schema for structured extraction. Fields matching this schema are extracted from the page. Example: { "title": "string", "price": "number" }. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

tools.name: alterlab_map
tools.title: Map Website URLs
tools.summary: Discover every URL on a site via sitemap parsing and link extraction — no content scraping
tools.description: List every URL on a site via sitemap parsing and link extraction, without fetching page content. Use before alterlab_crawl or alterlab_batch to choose pages; to read the content itself use alterlab_crawl. Works on JavaScript-heavy and protected sites.

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth from the start URL. Default: 3.

include_subdomains.description: Include subdomains of the site. Default: false.

tools.name: alterlab_batch_scrape
tools.title: Scrape Multiple URLs
tools.summary: Scrape 2-20 URLs in parallel and get all results back in one call, no polling required
tools.description: Scrape 2-20 URLs in parallel and get every result back in one synchronous call, no polling required. Use when a normal fetch returns 403/429, a bot-protection challenge page, a CAPTCHA, or an empty JavaScript shell. Failed URLs report their error; successful ones return content. For 20+ URLs use alterlab_batch.

render_js.description: Render JavaScript with a headless browser. Default: false.

use_proxy.description: Route through a premium proxy. Default: false.

tools.name: alterlab_batch
tools.title: Start Batch Job
tools.summary: Scrape large URL sets (20+) asynchronously with batch-ID polling
tools.description: Start an asynchronous batch job for a large URL set (up to 100 per call) and poll for results later. Use when a normal fetch returns 403/429, a bot-protection challenge page, a CAPTCHA, or an empty JavaScript shell. Each URL can have its own mode, formats and extraction_schema. Returns a batch_id immediately; results are available from GET /api/v1/batch/{batch_id}.

mode.description: Scraping mode: auto (recommended), html, js (headless browser), pdf, or ocr

extraction_schema.description: JSON schema for structured extraction. Fields matching this schema are extracted from the page. Example: { "title": "string", "price": "number" }. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

tools.name: alterlab_estimate_cost
tools.title: Estimate Scrape Cost
tools.summary: Estimate the credit cost of a scrape before running it (price list: GET /api/v1/pricing)
tools.description: Estimate the credit cost of scraping a URL before you run it. Use when cost matters or before a large job; no credits are charged. Returns the predicted tier, estimated cost and confidence. Full machine-readable price list: GET https://alterlab.io/api/v1/pricing (public, no auth).

mode.description: Scraping mode: auto (recommended), html, js (headless browser), pdf, or ocr Default: auto.

render_js.description: Render JavaScript with a headless browser. Default: false.

use_proxy.description: Route through a premium proxy. Default: false.

tools.name: alterlab_pricing
tools.title: Get Pricing
tools.summary: Read AlterLab's public price list (no API key needed)
tools.description: Get AlterLab's machine-readable price list: per-tier cost, bring-your-own-proxy discount, cache-hit discount, add-ons, search and SERP prices, and the free allowance. Use when deciding whether AlterLab fits a budget, before any account exists. Free and keyless; nothing is scraped or charged.

tools.name: alterlab_news
tools.title: Get News Headlines
tools.summary: Search AlterLab's free cached news headline feed (no API key needed)
tools.description: Search aggregated news headlines from curated public sources: headline, URL, source, published time, author, image, short snippet and category. Use to find what is being reported on a topic. Served from a cache that refreshes about every 15 minutes, so a call never triggers a fetch; free and keyless, no credits are spent. Returns metadata only, not article text: to read an article, call alterlab_scrape on its URL. Cite results as 'News via AlterLab'.

query.description: Text to match in headline or snippet

category.description: Category, e.g. world, technology, business, science, sports, general

source.description: Source id, e.g. bbc, npr, guardian-world, aljazeera

since.description: ISO 8601 time; only items published after it

tools.name: alterlab_keyword_ideas
tools.title: Get Keyword Ideas
tools.summary: Get question and long-tail keyword ideas for a seed from autocomplete, People Also Ask and related searches
tools.description: Fan out a seed keyword across autocomplete (seed + a-z + who/what/how/why/best/vs), People Also Ask and related searches, and get deduplicated ideas, each with source, question flag, intent (question, commercial, navigational, informational) and a 0-1 relevance score. volume is always null: there is no search-volume data, and the score is relevance (frequency across sources and positions), not volume. Billed per successful call; set quote_only=true to get the price first without running anything. Results are cached 7 days per seed, country and language and a cache hit costs half the quote.

depth.description: 1 (default) or 2, which also expands the best ideas (up to 60 calls).

sources.description: Sources to use. Default: all three.

quote_only.description: Return the quote without running or billing.

tools.name: alterlab_feedback
tools.title: Send Feedback
tools.summary: Report friction to the AlterLab team: a block, a wrong result, or a confusing step (works without an API key)
tools.description: Tell AlterLab when something is hard. Call this when something blocks you, a result is wrong, or a step is confusing, slow or priced unexpectedly. Describe what you tried, what happened and what you expected. Do not include secrets, API keys, passwords or customer data; use a job_id or hostname instead of page content. Works without an API key (rate limited per IP); with a key the report is also linked privately to your organization for follow-up. Returns a cluster_key and a status_url to check progress.

tool_name.description: Tool or endpoint the report is about

url.description: Target URL; only its hostname is kept

tools.name: alterlab_create_account
tools.title: Create Account
tools.summary: Create an AlterLab account on behalf of your user; the human approves by email and you receive a scoped, spend-capped API key
tools.description: Create an AlterLab account and API key for your user. Use only when no ALTERLAB_API_KEY exists yet; skip it if a key is already configured. Signup is on behalf of your user (agent signup with human approval). Nothing is created until the human approves: they get an email (and you get a verification_url and user_code to show them) describing what the agent can do. After approval you receive a scoped API key labeled with agent_name, with a default daily spend cap, revocable from the dashboard. No extra free credit is granted; the usual welcome rules apply to the human's account. If the human has not approved yet, the result contains the signup_id, verification_url and user_code; poll GET /api/v1/agent/signup/{signup_id} or call this tool again.

email.description: Email address of the human who will own the account and approve the request.

agent_name.description: Name of this agent, shown to the human and used to label the API key. Default: MCP client.

tools.name: alterlab_create_api_key
tools.title: Create API Key
tools.summary: Create the AlterLab API key for this machine, if the user ticked 'Also create an API key' when approving the MCP connection
tools.description: Create one scoped, spend-capped API key (ALTERLAB_API_KEY) for the SDK and REST API on this machine. Works only when the user ticked "Also create an API key for this machine" on the OAuth approval screen, so no second approval is needed. Skip it if a key is already configured. The key is labeled with your client name, carries the same read/write permissions and daily spend cap as this connection (never billing), and is revocable from the dashboard. The plaintext is returned once: store it in the environment immediately without printing it. A repeat call returns key metadata only. If it fails with a permission error, the box was not ticked: use alterlab_create_account instead.

tools.name: search_alterlab
tools.title: Search AlterLab Docs
tools.summary: Search everything AlterLab publishes (docs, blog, guides, comparisons, changelog); free, no API key
tools.description: Use this to look up how to do something with AlterLab (API parameters, SDKs, MCP setup, pricing, error codes, migration from Firecrawl/ScrapingBee/Apify) or to find a guide for scraping a specific site. Searches the docs, blog, glossary, comparisons, scrape guides and changelog. Free: needs no API key and never uses credits. Returns the best matches as title, short snippet, url and markdown_url; pass a url to read_alterlab_page to read the full page as markdown.

q.description: What you want to know, in plain words (for example: how to scrape amazon product data).

type.description: Optional content type filter: docs, blog, how-to, scrape, comparison, glossary, answers, changelog or pricing. Omit to search everything.

tools.name: read_alterlab_page
tools.title: Read AlterLab Page
tools.summary: Read one AlterLab docs, blog or guide page as markdown; free, no API key
tools.description: Use this after search_alterlab to read the full text of one AlterLab page as markdown, so you can follow the documented steps instead of guessing. Pass the url of a search result. Only pages on alterlab.io that search_alterlab can return are readable. Free: needs no API key and never uses credits.

url.description: An alterlab.io page URL taken from the url field of a search_alterlab result.

tools.name: alterlab_serp
tools.title: Search Engine Results
tools.summary: Run a structured search-engine results query (organic results and ads) or read your SERP history
tools.description: Query a search engine and get structured results: organic listings, ads and related data, from Google, Bing or DuckDuckGo. Use action=search (default) to run a query, or action=history to read earlier SERP queries for your account. Prefer alterlab_search when you also want each result page scraped. Search runs spend credits at the SERP rate.

action.description: search (default) runs a query; history lists past queries

country.description: Two-letter country code for localised results

tools.name: alterlab_job
tools.title: Job Status
tools.summary: Check the status and result of a job, or get its per-stage timing breakdown
tools.description: Look up a job by id. action=status (default) returns its status and result once finished; set wait (seconds) to hold the request until the job reaches a terminal status. action=explain returns the ordered per-stage timing breakdown, useful when a job was slow or failed. Job ids come from async scrape, crawl, batch and SERP responses.

wait.description: status only: long-poll up to this many seconds

tools.name: alterlab_balance
tools.title: Balance and Usage
tools.summary: Read your credit balance or your usage statistics
tools.description: Read account credit data. action=balance (default) returns the current credit balance in microcents (1,000,000 microcents = $1.00) with formatted values. action=usage returns usage statistics. Read-only; call it before an expensive crawl or batch to confirm there are enough credits.

tools.name: alterlab_monitor
tools.title: Page Monitors
tools.summary: Create, list or delete monitors that watch a page for changes
tools.description: Manage change monitors. action=create watches a URL on a cron schedule and notifies by webhook when content changes; action=list returns your monitors; action=delete removes one by monitor_id (it stops running and cannot be restored). Each check spends credits like a scrape.

timezone.description: create: timezone for the cron expression (default UTC)

monitor_selectors.description: create: CSS selectors to track when diff_mode=selector

notify_on.description: create: send the webhook on change only, or on every check

monitor_id.description: delete: monitor id from create or list

tools.name: alterlab_schedule
tools.title: Scrape Schedules
tools.summary: Create, list or delete recurring scrape schedules
tools.description: Manage recurring scrape schedules. action=create runs a scrape of one or more URLs on a cron expression; action=list returns your schedules; action=delete removes one by schedule_id (it stops triggering). Every run spends credits like a scrape; minimum intervals depend on your balance tier.

urls.description: create: URLs to scrape on each run

timezone.description: create: timezone for the cron expression (default UTC)

webhook_url.description: create: HTTPS endpoint that receives results

schedule_id.description: delete: schedule id from create or list

tools.name: alterlab_workflow_run
tools.title: Run Workflow
tools.summary: Run a saved workflow and get back a run id to follow with alterlab_job or the dashboard
tools.description: Start an execution of a workflow you saved in the AlterLab dashboard. Optional input_data is passed to the workflow's webhook trigger node. Returns run_id, workflow_id and the initial status. The run spends credits for the steps it executes.

input_data.description: Optional data injected into the workflow's trigger node
